column3: Although 容易 means easy, the phrase means it was hard, and the shorter 好容易 means exactly the same. It usually comes before 才, as in 好不容易才找到, to say you finally managed it.
column4: 我好不容易才找到这家店。
column5: 我好不容易才找到這家店。
column6: Wǒ hǎobùróngyì cái zhǎodào zhè jiā diàn.
column7: I had a hard time finding this shop.

column3: Very common as a polite excuse when you can't come or must leave (我有事, 先走了). 没事 is the opposite: nothing is wrong, never mind.
column6: Wǒ jīntiān yǒushì, bù néng qù.
column7: I have something to do today, so I can't go.

column3: Mostly inside words: 爆炸 (explode), 爆米花 (popcorn), 爆紅 (go viral). In cooking, 爆炒 means to stir-fry fast over high heat.

Rare on its own in speech, where mother is 媽媽; it lives in compounds such as 母亲, 母语 (mother tongue) and 母校 (one's old school), and 母的 says that an animal is female. It is 女, woman, with extra dots added to set it apart.
column4: 这只猫是公的还是母的？
column5: 這隻貓是公的還是母的？
column6: Zhè zhī māo shì gōng de háishi mǔ de?
column7: Is this cat a male or a female?

column3: Often used as 以…出名 (famous for…), and a person or place can be 出名 for something bad as well as good.
column6: Zhè jiā diàn yǐ niúròumiàn chūmíng.
column7: This shop is famous for its beef noodles.

column3: Also a very common spoken intensifier before an adjective, as in 超好吃 and 超貴; it is informal and typical of younger speakers.
column6: Zhè jiā de dàngāo chāo hǎochī.
column7: This place's cake is super delicious.

column3: A fixed pair for 'at home and abroad', used before a noun or after a word like 驰名, as in 驰名中外 (famous everywhere) and 中外合资 (a joint venture).
column4: 这座古城吸引了中外游客。
column5: 這座古城吸引了中外遊客。
column6: Zhè zuò gǔchéng xīyǐn le zhōngwài yóukè.
column7: This old city attracts visitors from China and abroad.

column3: The middle stretch of a period or process, such as a project, a plan or an illness; the neighbors are 前期 (early) and 后期 (late).
column4: 这个项目已经进入中期。
column5: 這個項目已經進入中期。
column7: The project has reached its middle phase.

column3: Two uses: living things growing back or being reborn (再生能力 is the power to regenerate), and recycling, as in 再生纸 (recycled paper) and 可再生能源 (renewable energy).
column4: 可再生能源越来越重要。
column5: 可再生能源越來越重要。
column6: Kě zàishēng néngyuán yuè lái yuè zhòngyào.
column7: Renewable energy is getting more and more important.

column3: It takes something gradually used up as its object: 消耗能量, 消耗体力, 消耗时间 (energy, strength, time). It fits calories and fuel too. The old meaning "news" is rare today. 耗 was originally written differently.
column6: Pǎobù huì xiāohào hěn duō rèliàng.
column7: Running burns a lot of calories.
